title: Euclid's Division Algorithm (HCF)

hero.headline: Finding HCF the Euclid Way
hero.subtext: Division Lemma ko baar-baar apply karke kisi bhi do numbers ka HCF turant nikaalo.

story.text: Bade numbers ka HCF factor-tree se nikalna slow hai. Euclid ka trick: bade number ko chhote se divide karo, phir divisor ko remainder se divide karo — ye process repeat karo jab tak remainder 0 na aa jaye. Jo aakhri non-zero divisor bacha, wahi HCF hai.

explanation.content: Do positive integers a aur b (jahan a > b) ka HCF nikaalne ke steps:
Step 1: Euclid's Lemma apply karo: a = bq + r
Step 2: Agar r = 0, to HCF = b. Agar r ≠ 0, to Lemma dobara apply karo b aur r par.
Step 3: Ye process repeat karte raho jab tak remainder 0 na ho jaye.

diagram.caption: Har step mein divisor aage badhta hai, remainder chhota hota jaata hai — jab tak 0 na aaye.

questions.question: Euclid's Division Algorithm mein HCF kab mil jaata hai?
options: Jab dono numbers barabar ho jaayein
questions.explanation: Jab remainder 0 aata hai, us step ka divisor hi HCF hota hai.

questions.question: HCF(18, 24) Euclid's Algorithm se kya hoga?
Euclid's Division Algorithm sirf tab kaam karta hai jab dono numbers even hon.
questions.explanation: Galat — ye algorithm kisi bhi do positive integers ke liye kaam karta hai, even ho ya odd.

notes: Bada number ko chhote se divide karke shuru karo
Har step mein divisor naya dividend, remainder naya divisor ban jaata hai
summary: Euclid's Division Algorithm HCF nikaalne ka sabse fast tareeka hai — sirf repeated division, no factorization needed.
